title: Baahubali: The Beginning
cast: Prabhas, Rana Daggubati, Anushka Shetty, Tamannaah Bhatia
description: In the ancient kingdom of Mahishmati, an adventurous and daring young man Shivudu pursues his love and in the process learns about his royal heritage, his father Amarendra Baahubali's legendary bravery, and the fierce battle against tyrant ruler Bhallaladeva.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
cast: Prabhas, Rana Daggubati, Anushka Shetty, Ramya Krishnan
description: When Shiva, the son of Bahubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom as Amarendra Baahubali battles betrayal, royal politics, and Kattappa's tragic duty.

title: RRR
cast: N. T. Rama Rao Jr., Ram Charan, Alia Bhatt, Ajay Devgn
description: A fearless revolutionary Alluri Sitarama Raju and an iron-willed Gond tribal protector Komaram Bheem forge an unexpected brotherhood in 1920s Delhi, joining forces to rebel against oppressive British colonial rulers to liberate their land and people.

title: Magadheera
cast: Ram Charan, Kajal Aggarwal, Dev Gill, Srihari
description: A bike stuntman Harsha is falsely accused of murdering his lover's father. In his quest for vengeance, he recalls his 400-year-old past life as warrior Kala Bhairava in the kingdom of Udaigarh who defended Princess Mithravinda against an evil commander.

title: Eega
cast: Nani, Samantha Ruth Prabhu, Sudeep
description: A murdered young man Nani is reincarnated as a common housefly to protect the woman he loves from a ruthless wealthy business tycoon who killed him, using wits, persistence, and miniature traps to seek retribution.

title: Pushpa: The Rise
cast: Allu Arjun, Rashmika Mandanna, Fahadh Faasil
description: Pushpa Raj, a coolie in the Seshachalam forests of Andhra Pradesh, rises through the ranks of an illegal red sandalwood smuggling syndicate with audacious courage and street smarts, sparking fierce rivalries with police superintendent Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
cast: Allu Arjun, Rashmika Mandanna, Fahadh Faasil
description: Pushpa Raj consolidates absolute dominance over the lucrative red sandalwood empire across international borders while clashing in a deadly psychological and physical showdown against vengeful police officer Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat.

title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
cast: Allu Arjun, Pooja Hegde, Tabu, Jayaram, Murali Sharma
description: Bantu is constantly neglected and mocked by his cynical father Valmiki. Upon learning that he was secretly swapped at birth with a millionaire's son, Bantu enters the lavish Vaikunthapurram household to discreetly protect his biological family from corporate villains.

title: Arjun Reddy
cast: Vijay Deverakonda, Shalini Pandey, Rahul Ramakrishna
description: Arjun Reddy Deshmukh, a high-functioning yet volatile alcoholic house surgeon with severe anger management issues, spirals into a self-destructive abyss of drugs and depression after being forced to separate from his beloved girlfriend Preethi.

title: Jersey
cast: Nani, Shraddha Srinath, Sathyaraj, Ronit Kamra
description: Arjun, a talented but failed thirty-six-year-old former cricketer, decides to resurrect his athletic career despite heart health risks and financial struggles, solely driven by his burning desire to fulfill his young son's simple wish for an Indian team jersey.

title: Mahanati
cast: Keerthy Suresh, Dulquer Salmaan, Samantha Ruth Prabhu, Vijay Deverakonda
description: A biographical chronicle depicting the dramatic life, legendary artistic career, meteoric stardom, tumultuous romance with Gemini Ganesan, and tragic downfall of legendary South Indian cinema queen Savitri.

title: Sita Ramam
cast: Dulquer Salmaan, Mrunal Thakur, Rashmika Mandanna, Sumanth
description: An orphaned Lieutenant Ram serving at the Kashmir border begins receiving anonymous letters filled with affection from a mysterious girl named Sita Mahalakshmi. When twenty years later Afreen embarks on delivering Ram's final letter, secrets unfurl.

title: Athadu
cast: Mahesh Babu, Trisha Krishnan, Sonu Sood, Prakash Raj
description: Nandu, a professional and meticulous contract killer, is framed for the assassination of a political leader. While evading police officer Anjaneya Prasad, he takes shelter in a village by assuming the identity of Pardhu, an innocent runaway.

title: Pokiri
cast: Mahesh Babu, Ileana D'Cruz, Prakash Raj, Nassar
description: Krishna Manohar is a fearless rogue mercenary who works for mafia cartels in Hyderabad, playing warring gangs against each other while secretly operating as an undercover IPS officer determined to eradicate organized underworld crime.

title: Okkadu
cast: Mahesh Babu, Bhumika Chawla, Prakash Raj, Mukesh Rishi
description: Ajay, a fearless Kabaddi player traveling to Kurnool for a tournament, rescues an innocent young woman Swapna from the clutches of an obsessive factionist Obul Reddy who wants to forcefully marry her, sheltering her in Charminar.

title: Rangasthalam
cast: Ram Charan, Samantha Ruth Prabhu, Aadhi Pinisetty, Jagapathi Babu
description: In the 1980s rural village of Rangasthalam, Chitti Babu, a partially hearing-impaired and fiercely loyal engineer, rallies to support his brother Kumar Babu in dismantling the tyrannical thirty-year reign of the corrupt village president Phanindra Bhupathi.

title: Mayabazar
cast: N. T. Rama Rao, Savitri, Akkineni Nageswara Rao, S. V. Ranga Rao
description: Based on the folk tale Sasirekha Parinayam, Lord Krishna and the mischievous demon Ghatotkacha conspire to foil the Kauravas' scheming plot and reunite Pandava prince Abhimanyu with Balarama's daughter Sasirekha.

title: Karthikeya 2
cast: Nikhil Siddharth, Anupama Parameswaran, Anupam Kher
description: Dr. Karthikeya, a rational doctor who questions superstitions, embarks on a perilous quest across Dwarka, Himachal Pradesh, and Greece to decipher ancient clues left behind by Lord Krishna to save humanity from impending catastrophic danger.

title: Dasara
cast: Nani, Keerthy Suresh, Dheekshith Shetty, Shine Tom Chacko
description: Set in the coal mines of Veerlapally, close childhood friends Dharani and Suri get entangled in ruthless village politics, caste rivalries, and the illicit alcohol trade at the local Silk Bar, leading to tragic heartbreak and blood-soaked retribution.

title: Salaar: Part 1 - Ceasefire
cast: Prabhas, Prithviraj Sukumaran, Shruti Haasan, Jagapathi Babu
description: In the dystopian fortified city-state of Khansaar ruled by ruthless tribal factions, Deva returns from exile to stand as an unstoppable one-man army beside his childhood friend Vardharaja Mannar in a vicious succession power struggle.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
cast: Prabhas, Amitabh Bachchan, Kamal Haasan, Deepika Padukone
description: In a post-apocalyptic desert world in the year 2898 AD inside the last city of Kasi, the legendary warrior Ashwatthama awakens to protect the unborn avatar of Vishnu, crossing paths with selfish bounty hunter Bhairava under the Complex's tyrannical ruler Supreme Yaskin.

title: Hanu-Man
cast: Teja Sajja, Amritha Aiyer, Varalaxmi Sarathkumar, Vinay Rai
description: In the fictional village of Anjanadri, a petty thief Hanumanthu stumbles upon a celestial solar gemstone that bestows him with the mythical divine powers of Lord Hanuman, compelling him to protect his village against a technologically equipped supervillain.

title: Geetha Govindam
cast: Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna, Subbaraju, Rahul Ramakrishna
description: Govind, a polite and traditional college lecturer searching for true love, is mistakenly branded a pervert by independent woman Geetha after an awkward misunderstanding on a bus. Complications multiply when his sister is engaged to marry Geetha's brother.

title: Goodachari
cast: Adivi Sesh, Sobhita Dhulipala, Jagapathi Babu, Prakash Raj
description: Gopi, the son of an ex-RAW officer, is recruited into the secretive Indian intelligence agency Trinetra. However, during his graduation mission he is framed for the assassination of his superior commanders and must unravel a sinister mole conspiracy.

title: Major
cast: Adivi Sesh, Saiee Manjrekar, Sobhita Dhulipala, Prakash Raj
description: An inspiring biographical drama celebrating the valor and courage of Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan, who valiantly led the elite 51 Special Action Group during the fateful 2008 Taj Mahal Palace terror attacks in Mumbai, saving hundreds of civilian lives.

title: HIT: The First Case
cast: Vishwak Sen, Ruhani Sharma, Murali Sharma, Bhanu Chander
description: Vikram, an officer in the Telangana Police Homicide Intervention Team dealing with severe past post-traumatic stress disorder, must race against the clock to solve the mysterious abduction of a college girl who vanished from the Outer Ring Road.

title: HIT: The Second Case
cast: Adivi Sesh, Meenakshi Chaudhary, Rao Ramesh, Suhas
description: Krishna Dev (KD), an easygoing Superintendent of Police in Vizag HIT, is thrust into a terrifying serial murder case when a woman's severed body parts are discovered in a club, leading him on the trail of a sadistic psychopath targeting working women.

title: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya
cast: Naveen Polishetty, Shruti Sharma, Suhas, Krishneswara Rao
description: A witty, Sherlock Holmes-obsessed small-town detective Agent Sai operates FBI (Fatima Bureau of Investigation) in Nellore. While investigating an unclaimed dead body near a railway track, he uncovers an expansive national organ racket and fake superstition syndicate.

title: Brochevarevarura
cast: Sree Vishnu, Nivetha Thomas, Nivetha Pethuraj, Satyadev Kancharana
description: Three slacker intermediate students R3 (Rahul, Rambo, Rocky) team up with their principal's rebellious daughter Mithra to stage a fake kidnapping to help her escape strict home confinement, triggering a hilarious comedy of errors with real criminals.

title: C/o Kancharapalem
cast: Subba Rao, Radha Bessy, Kesava Karri, Karthik Rathnam
description: Four unconventional and touching love stories spanning four different age groups, religions, and social backgrounds unfold in the vibrant, rustic neighborhood of Kancharapalem in Visakhapatnam, offering profound commentary on human affection and societal boundaries.

title: Sarileru Neekevvaru
cast: Mahesh Babu, Rashmika Mandanna, Vijayashanti, Prakash Raj
description: Major Ajay Krishna, an intrepid Army commando, is dispatched on a sensitive mission to Kurnool to comfort a martyred soldier's mother, only to find her embroiled in a dangerous political conflict against an all-powerful local syndicate boss.

title: Bharat Ane Nenu
cast: Mahesh Babu, Kiara Advani, Prakash Raj, R. Sarathkumar
description: After his father's sudden death, Oxford graduate Bharat Ram steps up to become the youngest Chief Minister of undivided Andhra Pradesh, implementing strict governance, transparency, traffic reforms, and accountability while combating political corruption.

title: Srimanthudu
cast: Mahesh Babu, Shruti Haasan, Jagapathi Babu, Rajendra Prasad
description: Harsha Vardhan, the idealistic billionaire heir of a massive corporate empire, rejects material inheritance to adopt an impoverished backward village named Devarakota, striving to provide clean water, schools, and dignity to its villagers.

title: Race Gurram
cast: Allu Arjun, Shruti Haasan, Shaam, Ravi Kishan
description: Two brothers, Ram an upright ACP and Lucky a carefree non-conformist, have contrasting lifestyles. When an extortionist politician Shiva Reddy targets Ram's family, Lucky engages in an eccentric, high-voltage war of wits and action to finish him off.

title: DJ: Duvvada Jagannadham
cast: Allu Arjun, Pooja Hegde, Rao Ramesh, Subbaraju
description: Duvvada Jagannadham is an orthodox Brahmin catering cook who secretly doubles as DJ, a ruthless vigilante operative trained by an honest police officer to eliminate corrupt criminals and land grabbers who evade court justice.

title: Shyam Singha Roy
cast: Nani, Sai Pallavi, Krithi Shetty, Madonna Sebastian
description: A contemporary aspiring filmmaker Vasu begins having vivid subconscious flashes of his past life in 1970s Bengal as revolutionary author Shyam Singha Roy, who fought against the oppressive Devadasi tradition to protect his beloved dancer Maitreyi.

title: Virupaksha
cast: Sai Dharam Tej, Samyuktha Menon, Sunil, Brahmaji
description: In the remote 1990s village of Rudravanam, mysterious unexplained deaths occur following an ancient occult curse. Surya arrives in town and initiates a terrifying investigation into black magic, dark tantric rituals, and hidden village secrets.

title: Arundhati
cast: Anushka Shetty, Sonu Sood, Sayaji Shinde, Manorama
description: Arundhati, the great-granddaughter of the valorous Queen Jejamma of Gadwal, returns to her ancestral palace where she faces the resurrected, malevolent spirit of dark sorcerer Pasupathi whom Jejamma had buried alive decades ago.

title: Bommarillu
cast: Siddharth, Genelia D'Souza, Prakash Raj, Jayasudha
description: Siddhu has grown up under the stifling, over-protective control of his father Aravind. When he unexpectedly falls in love with the exuberant, carefree Hasini, Siddhu must muster the courage to teach his father the meaning of trust and autonomy.

title: Mathu Vadalara
cast: Sri Simha Koduri, Satya, Naresh Agastya, Vennela Kishore
description: Babu, a broke and sleep-deprived delivery boy, tries to earn quick pocket cash through petty delivery cheats. However, inside an upscale apartment complex he unexpectedly stumbles across an old woman's corpse and becomes trapped in a drug racket.

title: Jathi Ratnalu
cast: Naveen Polishetty, Priyadarshi, Rahul Ramakrishna, Faria Abdullah
description: Three naive and eccentric best friends from Jogipet relocate to Hyderabad seeking respect and high-paying jobs, only to be framed for an assassination attempt on a prominent state minister in a riotous comedy of court trials.

title: Tillu Square
cast: Siddu Jonnalagadda, Anupama Parameswaran, Muralidhar Goud
description: DJ Tillu returns with his eccentric antics, only to fall head over heels for the alluring Lilly. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of international intelligence agents, mafia assassins, and double crossings.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
cast: Yash, Srinidhi Shetty, Ramachandra Raju, Archana Jois
description: Rocky, a fierce young mercenary from Bombay slums, journeys to the deadly Kolar Gold Fields disguised as a laborer with an undercover assignment to assassinate the barbaric tyrant Garuda who enslaves gold mine workers.

title: Dangal
cast: Aamir Khan, Fatima Sana Shaikh, Sanya Malhotra, Sakshi Tanwar
description: Former amateur wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat overcomes gender stereotypes and societal scorn by training his daughters Geeta and Babita to become world-class wrestling champions at the Commonwealth Games.

title: Jawan
cast: Shah Rukh Khan, Nayanthara, Vijay Sethupathi, Deepika Padukone
description: A former commando Azad leads a team of six daring women on hijackings and hostage operations across India to demand justice for farmers, hospital healthcare corruption, and expose an arms tycoon Kalees.

title: Brahmāstra: Part One - Shiva
cast: Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, Amitabh Bachchan, Nagarjuna Akkineni
description: Shiva, a Mumbai DJ with a supernatural immunity to fire, discovers his connection to the ancient secret Brahmānsh society and embarks on a quest to unlock the divine Brahmāstra before dark forces obtain it.

title: Vikram
cast: Kamal Haasan, Vijay Sethupathi, Fahadh Faasil, Suriya
description: A high-profile black-ops squad leader Amar is tasked with investigating a series of masked vigilante killings tied to a missing cocaine container and drug kingpin Sandhanam, discovering the truth about legendary agent Vikram.

title: Kantara
cast: Rishab Shetty, Sapthami Gowda, Kishore, Achyuth Kumar
description: In a coastal village of Karnataka, a hot-tempered Kambala champion Shiva clashes with a strict forest officer Murali over forest land rights, intertwining with ancestral Bhoota Kola demigod folklore and spiritual destiny.

title: 3 Idiots
cast: Aamir Khan, R. Madhavan, Sharman Joshi, Kareena Kapoor, Boman Irani
description: Two college friends search for their long-lost eccentric companion Rancho while reminiscing about their engineering college days under strict director Virus and how Rancho taught them to pursue excellence over success.

title: Manjummel Boys
cast: Soubin Shahir, Sreenath Bhasi, Balu Varghese, Ganapathi
description: A group of fun-loving friends from Kochi travel to Kodaikanal for a vacation, where their trip turns into a harrowing survival mission when one of them falls into the treacherous, 900-foot deep Guna Caves.
